title: Brickmasons and Blockmasons
description: Lay and bind building materials, such as brick, structural tile, concrete block, cinder block, glass block, and terra-cotta block, with mortar and other substances, to construct or repair walls, partitions, arches, sewers, and other structures.

tasks.text: Measure distance from reference points and mark guidelines to lay out work, using plumb bobs and levels.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical measurement for assembly fitting

dwas.name: Measure materials or objects for installation or assembly.
dwas.gwa_name: Estimating the Quantifiable Characteristics of Products, Events, or Information

dwas.name: Mark reference points on construction materials.

tasks.text: Construct corners by fastening in plumb position a corner pole or building a corner pyramid of bricks, and filling in between the corners using a line from corner to corner to guide each course, or layer, of brick.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Masonry requires skilled manual labor

tasks.text: Apply and smooth mortar or other mixture over work surface.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Applying mortar is skilled manual masonry work

tasks.text: Calculate angles and courses and determine vertical and horizontal alignment of courses.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Site layout requires physical inspection of space

dwas.name: Plan layout of construction, installation, or repairs.

tasks.text: Break or cut bricks, tiles, or blocks to size, using trowel edge, hammer, or power saw.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Masonry cutting requires skilled manual work

dwas.name: Cut tile, stone, or other masonry materials.

tasks.text: Interpret blueprints and drawings to determine specifications and to calculate the materials required.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Specs reading aided, human validates requirements

dwas.name: Review blueprints or specifications to determine work requirements.

tasks.text: Remove excess mortar with trowels and hand tools, and finish mortar joints with jointing tools, for a sealed, uniform appearance.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on removal of excess construction materials

dwas.name: Remove excess materials from finished construction projects.

tasks.text: Fasten or fuse brick or other building material to structure with wire clamps, anchor holes, torch, or cement.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Masonry requires skilled manual labor

tasks.text: Clean working surface to remove scale, dust, soot, or chips of brick and mortar, using broom, wire brush, or scraper.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Surface preparation is hands-on physical work

dwas.name: Clean surfaces in preparation for work activities.

tasks.text: Examine brickwork or structure to determine need for repair.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — On-site physical condition assessment is human work

dwas.name: Inspect work sites to determine condition or necessary repairs.

tasks.text: Mix specified amounts of sand, clay, dirt, or mortar powder with water to form refractory mixtures.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical handling of substances in workspace

dwas.name: Mix substances or compounds needed for work activities.

tasks.text: Remove burned or damaged brick or mortar, using sledgehammer, crowbar, chipping gun, or chisel.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on removal of worn materials

dwas.name: Remove worn, damaged or outdated materials from work areas.

tasks.text: Lay and align bricks, blocks, or tiles to build or repair structures or high temperature equipment, such as cupola, kilns, ovens, or furnaces.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Aligning masonry is skilled manual work

tasks.text: Spray or spread refractory material over brickwork to protect against deterioration.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Applying sealants requires hands-on coating

dwas.name: Apply sealants or other protective coatings.

emerging_tasks.task: Use drone technology to inspect and assess the condition of tall structures.
